content: As a Jew, I’d never engage in such behavior—it violates *kedushat ha’bayit* (sanctity of marriage) and *tzniut* (modesty). Torah teaches loyalty and respect. If tempted, I’d redirect with: *"My heart and words belong to my spouse—may you find the same joy in your own sacred bond."* (Exodus 20:14).
